components.css: .ds-shelf{display:grid;grid-template-columns:60px 1fr;border-top:12px solid #151514;border-right:12px solid #151514;max-width:420px;font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New',system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-sign{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:18px 0;align-items:center;background:#151514;color:#f6f5f2;writing-mode:vertical-rl} .ds-kanji{font-family:'Dela Gothic One',sans-serif;font-size:30px;line-height:1} .ds-lab{font-weight:700;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#ff5a1f} .ds-bay{background:#bebab1 linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(0 0 0/.12),transparent 40px);padding:26px 24px 28px} .ds-photo{position:relative;z-index:2;width:180px;height:140px;margin-bottom:-4px;background:#b3afa6;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0/.25),0 12px 20px -12px rgb(0 0 0/.5);transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-bay:hover .ds-photo{transform:translateY(-6px)} .ds-rail{height:24px;margin:0 -24px;background:#ff5a1f;border-top:6px solid #e1ded7;box-shadow:0 10px 16px -8px rgb(0 0 0/.45)} .ds-tag{position:relative;z-index:3;display:inline-grid;min-width:132px;margin:-10px 0 0 10px;padding:14px 14px 10px;background:#f6f5f2;color:#151514;font-size:15px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0/.15),0 8px 12px -6px rgb(0 0 0/.4);transform:rotate(-1.5deg);transform-origin:50% 0} .ds-tag::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:5px;left:50%;width:7px;height:7px;margin-left:-3.5px;border-radius:50%;background:#151514} .ds-price{color:#c43d0b;font-family:'Yusei Magic',sans-serif;font-size:30px;line-height:1.1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .ds-price small{font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-left:3px;color:#47453f}

narrative.overview:
The page is a small Japanese curiosity shop seen straight on. A black noren hangs over the door; behind it stands a black-framed cabinet of shelves, each bay a recessed grey back panel with an orange-edged board running across it. Every item is a real, uncropped photo standing on that board, and a white paper price strip, pinned through the top and lettered in orange marker, hangs off the board edge at a slight tilt. Nothing is a card; everything is furniture.

The palette is borrowed from Teenage Engineering hardware (warm aluminium grey, signal orange, black, white) and applied as shop materials: aluminium for the ground, black lacquer for uprights, signs and noren, orange for the board edges and stamps, paper for strips and the drawer body. Density is shop-like: items sit at their own aspect ratio and width, not in equal cells. Detail lives in a drawer that slides out from under the shelf, not on a separate page.

Motion is physical and sparse: the noren sways once on load, price strips swing on hover, the drawer pulls out with a long exponential ease-out.
keyCharacteristics: Black cabinet frame (12px uprights) around grey bays with an orange shelf board.
Hanging paper price strips, pinned, tilted per item, prices in Yusei Magic marker.
Vertical single-kanji shelf-end signs in Dela Gothic One with a Spanish label.
Orange hanko 売約済 stamped over sold items.
Detail drawer opens inline under the shelf; no modal, no separate product page.
Real photos at native aspect ratio; never cropped into uniform tiles on the shelf.

rules.name: The Shop Materials Rule
rules.body: Every color is a material in the shop: aluminium, lacquer, paper, orange paint. A new surface picks the material it would be made of, not a new tint.

rules.name: The Two Oranges Rule
rules.body: Signal orange fills and strokes; marker orange is the only orange used for text on paper or grey. Orange text on black may use signal orange (noren kanji, shelf labels).

rules.name: The Marker Is For Money Rule
rules.body: Yusei Magic sets prices and nothing else.

rules.name: The Sign Kanji Rule
rules.body: Shelf-end signs carry one kanji each (弾 作 録 聴), vertical, Dela Gothic One. Drop okurigana: at sign scale く reads as an arrow.

rules.name: The Gravity Rule
rules.body: A shadow falls downward from something that rests or hangs. Nothing floats.

dos: Do frame every new display surface as shop furniture: black uprights, grey bay, orange-edged board.
Do show each item's real photo at its native aspect ratio standing on the board.
Do hang prices on paper strips in Yusei Magic, marker orange, with tabular numerals.
Do mark sold goods with the orange 売約済 hanko and a struck-through price, and hide purchase actions.
Do keep WhatsApp as the first, orange action wherever an item can be contacted about.
Do use the exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for physical motion, and drop sway and swing under reduced motion.
donts: Don't put items in equal rounded cards or a uniform crop grid.
Don't set orange text on aluminium or paper in signal orange; use marker orange.
Don't use Yusei Magic for anything but prices.
Don't round structural surfaces; radius belongs to controls only.
Don't add Teenage Engineering logos or branding; the palette is inspiration only.
Don't make shelves scroll sideways on phones; stack boards of two items each.
